response.overview: 8 years since the first Keeshlife movie and 5 years since number two, here we are presenting Keesh 3 for you – featuring the Keesh OG's & great friends. The whole thing is filmed, edited, and crafted in the original Keesh do-it-yourself style, like always. Filmed in Finnish and Swedish Lapland, the streets of Southern Finland, and the French & Swiss Alps.
response.title: KEESH 3
